value.rationale: A precise four-component count and exact three gap endpoints at the first integer parameter beyond the connectedness range answer a motivating restricted-divisor-function component problem. The squarefree restriction is natural and essential; the claim is neither a mere special case of the unrestricted two-component statement nor an arbitrary finite numerical slice. Explains structurally why exactly two small primes cause every gap.
